state.initial_message: I downgraded my plan but I am still being billed for the higher tier.

messages.content:
CREATE_TICKET: Downgrade to lower tier not reflected in billing cycle despite active account status.

I understand how stressful unexpected charges can be, especially when you have already taken steps to adjust your plan. I have verified your account details and confirmed that while your account is active, the billing system is still processing charges for the Platinum tier.

To resolve this, I have initiated a manual review with our billing team. Here is what you can expect next:

1.  **Immediate Action:** Our team will correct your billing profile to reflect the intended lower tier.
2.  **Refund Process:** Any overage charged for the current cycle will be refunded to your original payment method. Please allow 3–5 business days for this credit to appear.
3.  **Confirmation:** You will receive an email confirmation once the correction is complete and the refund is issued.

No further action is required from you at this time. We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience while we ensure your billing aligns with your chosen plan.

Escalation ticket created: TCKT_C7BC79
Our billing team will contact you within 24 hours.
